title: Air Force cooperation with Stargate
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Air Force cooperation with Stargate, about 1997-2000s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In fact, two sitting Air Force Chiefs of Staff, Michael E. Ryan and John P. Jumper appeared on the show as themselves.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels points to Stargate, a science fiction TV show starring Richard Dean Anderson that ran from the late 1990s, about soldiers travelling to other worlds. He says that two sitting Air Force Chiefs of Staff, the top uniformed officers of the US Air Force, Michael E. Ryan and John P. Jumper, appeared on the show as themselves. He tells it as a sign that the Air Force cooperated closely with the show, which he suggests could mean it wanted to shape how the public thinks about such ideas.
